data.name: Heeransh
data.gender_notes: Heeransh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Heeransh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Heera' meaning 'Lord' and 'Ansh' meaning 'Manifestation' or 'Presence'. This name is believed to denote the one who is the manifestation of the universe itself. It is a powerful and revered name in Hindu tradition. The name Heeransh carries the meaning “Lord of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Heeransh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Heeransh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Heeransh total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

historical_references.reference: Heeransh was a legendary king of the Yadava dynasty, ruling in the late 11th or early 12th century CE in the region of present-day Gujarat, India.
historical_references.context: The Yadava dynasty was a Jain dynasty that ruled various parts of present-day Gujarat and Rajasthan in western India from the 9th to the 13th century CE.

historical_references.reference: Heeransh is also known as Harihar, and is mentioned in various Hindu literary works as a great warrior and an embodiment of the god Hari (Vishnu).
historical_references.context: Harihar is a popular name in Hinduism that is often used to refer to Hari (Vishnu) and Harishchandra, a legendary king and an avatar of Vishnu.
